::: {#exr-bikeshare-histogram}

#### A histogram of the hourly count

The [`Bikeshare` data](#sec-bikeshare-lab) count the bikes rented in each of many hours, as `bikers`.
A [histogram](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-histogram) shows the shape of the whole set of counts.

::: {.callout-tip}

#### Hint

`ggplot2::geom_histogram()` in R, `hist()` in base R, and `ax.hist()` from matplotlib in Python draw a [histogram](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-histogram).

:::

Draw a [histogram](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-histogram) of `bikers`.

:::
